description: Bring the Fuel tab to life: users can log, view, edit, and delete fill-ups with blur-triggered auto-calculation of the third fuel field; the system computes per-fill-up MPG when valid (and suppresses it for partial/first/adjacent-partial fill-ups) and maintains correct sorting and recalculation after edits/deletes.

tasks.title: Fuel log domain events + commands + validation
tasks.description: Implement the FuelLogs vertical slice using event sourcing. Add commands and events from the Sprint 03 brief: `RecordFuelLogCommand` (with client-generated `commandId` idempotency key), `UpdateFuelLogCommand`, `DeleteFuelLogCommand`; emit `FuelLogRecorded`, `FuelLogUpdated`, `FuelLogDeleted`. Enforce validation rules: date not in future; odometer positive int ≤ 9,999,999; at least two of {gallons,totalCost,pricePerGallon} on submit; numeric precision and max values per brief; notes ≤500; allow $0.00 cost and price/gal 0.000.
acceptanceCriteria: RecordFuelLogCommand rejects submissions with fewer than two fuel fields with the specified error
Future dates are rejected with "Date can't be in the future"
Duplicate RecordFuelLogCommand with same commandId is idempotent

tasks.title: FuelLogList projection + sorting + lastOdometer
tasks.description: Create a Marten projection for `FuelLogList { vehicleId, logs, lastOdometer }` per Sprint 03 contract. Sort logs by date desc, then odometer desc for same-date ties. Compute lastOdometer as the most recent recorded odometer reading for the vehicle.
acceptanceCriteria: FuelLogList.logs are sorted date desc, odometer desc for ties
lastOdometer reflects the newest reading by date/odometer ordering
Deleted logs are removed from the list projection

tasks.title: Server-side MPG computation (with suppression rules)
tasks.description: Compute `mpg` server-side for each FuelLog in the read model using the Sprint 03 rules: mpg = (current odometer − prior odometer) / current gallons. Suppress MPG (mpg = null) when: first fill-up (no prior), current isPartialFillUp, or prior fill-up isPartialFillUp. Ensure mpg values are recalculated correctly when a log is edited or deleted and when the baseline prior log changes.
acceptanceCriteria: MPG is null for the first fill-up and for any partial fill-up
MPG is null for the fill-up immediately after a partial fill-up
Editing/deleting a fill-up causes adjacent mpg values to update according to the new prior baseline

tasks.title: HTTP API contract for fuel logs
tasks.description: Define and implement the HTTP API for Sprint 03 (api-developer + backend-builder): endpoints to fetch FuelLogList for a vehicle (including lastOdometer), record a fuel log, update a fuel log, and delete a fuel log. Ensure response shapes match the brief’s `FuelLog` and `FuelLogList` contracts, including `calculatedField` and `mpg`.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend can fetch FuelLogList with mpg and calculatedField for each log
Record/update/delete endpoints return appropriate success and validation errors
API respects ownership scoping (404 for other user’s vehicle/log)

tasks.title: Fuel tab UI: list + log fill-up form with auto-calc state machine
tasks.description: Implement the Vehicle Detail → Fuel tab populated UI per Sprint 03: reverse-chronological list cards, optional MPG badge, partial tag, notes indicator, and overflow menu (Edit/Delete). Add Log Fill-up page with fields/validation and the specified auto-calculation UX: field states empty/userEntered/calculated; calculate on blur when exactly two fields are userEntered; show "calc" pill on calculated field; handle editing calculated field (becomes userEntered and reassign calculated field using LIFO rule); handle all-three consistent (no calc); all-three inconsistent shows gentle note and prioritizes gallons+totalCost → recalc pricePerGallon.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto-calculation fires on blur (not keystroke) and visually marks the calculated field
If all three fields are inconsistent, UI shows the specified inline note and recalculates price/gal using gallons+totalCost
Fuel list shows MPG badge only when mpg is non-null and hides it otherwise (no placeholder)

tasks.title: Edit/delete fuel log flows
tasks.description: Implement Edit Fill-up page (pre-populated) with calc labeling, save changes flow, and delete flow. Delete must use a confirmation dialog (not undo toast) with the specified copy. After successful delete, the list updates and MPG badges reflect the server’s recalculated mpg values.
acceptanceCriteria: Edit Fill-up pre-populates all fields and saves successfully
Delete action requires confirmation dialog and on success removes the entry
After edit/delete, the fuel list re-renders with correct sorting and mpg visibility

tasks.title: Tests: mpg rules + auto-calc UX
tasks.description: Add tests for Sprint 03: backend tests for mpg suppression rules and sorting; frontend unit tests for the auto-calc state machine (including LIFO reassignment and inconsistent triple-input behavior); and a Playwright flow for log/edit/delete fill-up.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend test covers partial suppression and adjacent recalculation behavior
Frontend unit tests cover the auto-calc rules (two fields → third calc, LIFO reassignment, inconsistent triple input)
Playwright test covers logging a fill-up and seeing it appear in the Fuel tab
